g.text: Active fields support MIME and size checks,
The Gateway owns the attachment bytes for this request.
This is an implemented product boundary, not a defect.
General attachment input remains outside the v1 wire contract.
Public clients use chat_id and never receive session_id.
Attachment metadata and Runtime use session_id and never store chat_id.
The OBS Object Key is exactly attachment_id.
Resolve returns no OBS URL or credential.
Runtime never accesses OBS directly and writes no local file.
OBJECT_KEY_CONFLICT remains quarantined from ordinary deletion;
only audited reconciliation may remove an object after ownership proof.
After OBS deletion, active detail is removed and the permanent
DELETED tombstone retains only the five identity and audit fields.
chat_id, multipart upload, and poll READY
